title: India court grants Dabur interim relief against food regulator's order over '100%' claims
description: ​On ‌August 3, the FSSAI ‌said products sold ​on Dabur’s website claimed ⁠some of its products were “100% Natural”, “100% Pure” ‌and “100% Organic”, which were ambiguous, unverifiable and likely to mislead consumers
